description: Governor's Office - Western Province - Extension of the term of the Investigation of single person Inquiry Board by three months
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the extension of an inquiry being conducted by a judicial officer (retired Judge of the Court of Appeal) into potential offenses committed by a local government body and its chairman. The content is focused on a law enforcement and judicial investigation process, falling squarely under the "Judicial/Law Enforcement" category (Type 9) for matters related to legal proceedings, judicial appointments to inquiry boards, and law enforcement regulations.
